workflows:abort.description: Abort an in-flight workflow instance — a hard stop: pending effects are cancelled, stage guards removed, and the instance is marked terminal where it stands.

workflows:deploy.description: Validate workflow definitions, check any generated runtime beside the config against them, then diff and deploy to the resource bound by the selected deployment. A generated runtime that no longer matches the definitions fails the deploy before anything is written; regenerate it with `sanity-workflows blueprints generate`.

share-defs.description: Share the definition documents newly created by this deploy with Sanity — the full document, verbatim (structure, names, filters, effect configuration, seeded values), plus its deployment coordinates (project and dataset, or resource id); never content documents, instances, or your Sanity auth token. Sharing is the default in every environment, including CI / non-TTY / DO_NOT_TRACK. Use --no-share-defs to opt out.

workflows:definitions:validate.description: Validate workflow definitions in JSON files without a config, login, or network access. Checks shape, cross-field rules, and GROQ syntax; deploy additionally checks duplicate names, spawn dependencies, resource bindings, project roles, and the reader-model acknowledgement. Exits non-zero when any definition is invalid. A file that cannot be read, is not valid JSON, or does not hold definition objects stops the command with an error message instead of a report, including with --json.
examples: <%= config.bin %> workflows definitions validate parent.json child.json

Covers every deployment in the config, because the emitted resources module declares them all. These flags and this output may change before the Blueprints backend accepts the sanity.workflow resource.
